method.delay: ns3_rx_ns - actual admission_ns, scheduled SENDAT transmit boundary
method.unit: ns3 simulation ms, complete application transport across CSMA/AP/WiFi/reassembly; not pure airtime or Linux wall
method.percentiles: nearest rank ceil(p*n); median midpoint for even n
method.missing: Unobserved complete message at last Native horizon, not automatically PHY loss; no ledger loss attribution
method.phase: Only cohorts use same-host Hub ingress mono relative to C normalstart and first actual guardtrip; numerical delay always N-N
method.sampling: Delivered-only delays, absent messages reported separately; per-message weighting, not byte-weighted

limits: Real Guard/Action failure remains. Native/HUB successful exit is only a transport sub-result.
A1 Disk vs B RAM and CPU/IPC/controlled-time/RTF confounding remains.
No real Nav2/Gazebo/Policy. No formal loss rate or pure wireless performance attribution.
